## Specific task description

Task instruction: Direct the left arm to click the smooth metal bell's top.

Task description: This round’s target is the smooth silver metal bell on the black base at the front left of the table. Use the left arm to tap its top.

Success criteria: The left gripper is closed and actually contacts the designated click area on top of the bell. Merely hovering above the bell does not count.

## Execution tips

- Consider using the fingertips of the closed gripper to touch and press down lightly from above the bell. Reduce the descent step near the surface to avoid sliding sideways or colliding along the curved metal surface.
- Aim the physical contact surface of the fingertip at the bell’s top press target. Avoid aligning only the gap between the two fingers to the target, which could leave the end effector at its destination without contact.
